A luxury Wagyu restaurant in Dubai serving incredible Matsusaka beef steak!

Made with premium Matsusaka beef from Japan, the steak is carefully cooked to bring out its exceptional tenderness, rich marbling, and deep umami flavor.

Every bite melts in your mouth, delivering the delicate sweetness and luxurious richness that Matsusaka beef is famous for.

A must-visit destination for anyone looking to experience one of Japan’s finest Wagyu brands in Dubai.

“KEN by Kamatsuda”
